items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, some of the, the Claiborne Williams group up in Donkersonville.

ctx.x: There was a funny thing when I left home, for people not speaking to people. You know what I mean? Especially around New York, around Central Ocean. Just like, right? See, you'll meet people that don't say nothing to you. Meet people, and that used to almost kill me. You know what I mean? Yeah, it's funny, huh? See, people, you'll speak to people that look at you, like they're assaulted with you, see? But you have to soon get used to, get used to that around New York, see? Mm-hmm. The people going about their…
Oh, some of the, the Claiborne Williams group up in Donkersonville. Yeah. Okay.
